dialogue.text: Once upon a time there was a small town far from the city.
dialogue.zh: 從前有一個遠離城市的小鎮。
dialogue.ja: 昔々、都会から遠く離れた小さな町がありました。
dialogue.local: Once upon a time there was a small town far from the city.
dialogue.en: Once upon a time there was a small town far from the city.

dialogue.text: In this town lived a witch whom everyone made fun of.
dialogue.zh: 在這個鎮上住著一位被大家取笑的女巫。
dialogue.ja: その町には、みんなにからかわれている魔女が住んでいました。
dialogue.local: In this town lived a witch whom everyone made fun of.
dialogue.en: In this town lived a witch whom everyone made fun of.

dialogue.text: This witch named Fury was so clumsy.
dialogue.zh: 這位名叫Fury的女巫非常笨拙。
dialogue.ja: その魔女の名前はフューリーで、とても不器用でした。
dialogue.local: This witch named Fury was so clumsy.
dialogue.en: This witch named Fury was so clumsy.

dialogue.text: One day, the witch Fury was preparing a potion to do her usual evil deeds.
dialogue.zh: 有一天，女巫Fury正在準備魔藥，準備做她平常的壞事。
dialogue.ja: ある日、魔女フューリーはいつもの悪事をするために魔法の薬を作っていました。
dialogue.local: One day, the witch Fury was preparing a potion to do her usual evil deeds.
dialogue.en: One day, the witch Fury was preparing a potion to do her usual evil deeds.

dialogue.text: Bobby, get out of here!
dialogue.zh: Bobby，快出去！
dialogue.ja: ボビー、ここから出て行け！
dialogue.local: Bobby, get out of here!
dialogue.en: Bobby, get out of here!

dialogue.text: He will pour out this potion of unhappiness that I will deal out to the people.
dialogue.zh: 他會把我準備給人們的不幸魔藥灑出來。
dialogue.ja: 彼が私が人々に与えようとしている不幸の魔薬をこぼしてしまうの。
dialogue.local: He will pour out this potion of unhappiness that I will deal out to the people.
dialogue.en: He will pour out this potion of unhappiness that I will deal out to the people.

dialogue.text: Witch Fury's spoil dog was not standing still.
dialogue.zh: 女巫Fury那隻被寵壞的狗不肯安靜。
dialogue.ja: 魔女フューリーの甘やかされた犬はじっとしていませんでした。
dialogue.local: Witch Fury's spoil dog was not standing still.
dialogue.en: Witch Fury's spoil dog was not standing still.

dialogue.text: He was running around.
dialogue.zh: 牠到處亂跑。
dialogue.ja: 彼はあちこち走り回っていました。
dialogue.local: He was running around.
dialogue.en: He was running around.

dialogue.text: Whoof!
dialogue.zh: 汪！
dialogue.ja: ワン！
dialogue.local: Whoof!
dialogue.en: Whoof!

dialogue.text: Bobby! Enough is enough!
dialogue.zh: Bobby！夠了夠了！
dialogue.ja: ボビー！もうやめなさい！
dialogue.local: Bobby! Enough is enough!
dialogue.en: Bobby! Enough is enough!

dialogue.text: Meanwhile, Witch Fury accidentally put too much sugar in the potion cauldron.
dialogue.zh: 同時，女巫Fury不小心在魔藥鍋裡放了太多糖。
dialogue.ja: その間に、魔女フューリーは誤って魔法の薬の鍋に砂糖を入れすぎてしまいました。
dialogue.local: Meanwhile, Witch Fury accidentally put too much sugar in the potion cauldron.
dialogue.en: Meanwhile, Witch Fury accidentally put too much sugar in the potion cauldron.

dialogue.text: I didn't realize it.
dialogue.zh: 我沒注意到。
dialogue.ja: 気づかなかったの。
dialogue.local: I didn't realize it.
dialogue.en: I didn't realize it.

dialogue.text: When she took the potion she filled in a small bottle and started casting spells.
dialogue.zh: 當她把魔藥裝進小瓶子裡，開始施法時。
dialogue.ja: 彼女は魔薬を小さな瓶に入れて、呪文を唱え始めました。
dialogue.local: When she took the potion she filled in a small bottle and started casting spells.
dialogue.en: When she took the potion she filled in a small bottle and started casting spells.

dialogue.text: Let the laughter turn into tears!
dialogue.zh: 讓笑聲變成眼淚！
dialogue.ja: 笑いが涙に変わりますように！
dialogue.local: Let the laughter turn into tears!
dialogue.en: Let the laughter turn into tears!

dialogue.text: Joys into troubles and dreams into nightmares!
dialogue.zh: 快樂變成麻煩，夢想變成噩夢！
dialogue.ja: 喜びが困難に、夢が悪夢に変わりますように！
dialogue.local: Joys into troubles and dreams into nightmares!
dialogue.en: Joys into troubles and dreams into nightmares!

dialogue.text: Just then, spoiled Bobby got tangled in the witch's feet.
dialogue.zh: 就在這時，被寵壞的Bobby纏住了女巫的腳。
dialogue.ja: その時、甘やかされたボビーが魔女の足に絡まってしまいました。
dialogue.local: Just then, spoiled Bobby got tangled in the witch's feet.
dialogue.en: Just then, spoiled Bobby got tangled in the witch's feet.

dialogue.text: The witch stumbled and tripped on her broom next to the table.
dialogue.zh: 女巫絆倒了，撞到了桌子旁的掃帚。
dialogue.ja: 魔女はつまずいて、テーブルのそばのほうきに引っかかりました。
dialogue.local: The witch stumbled and tripped on her broom next to the table.
dialogue.en: The witch stumbled and tripped on her broom next to the table.

dialogue.text: And some of the potion in the bottle spilled onto the dog.
dialogue.zh: 瓶子裡的魔藥灑到了狗身上。
dialogue.ja: 瓶の中の魔薬が犬にこぼれてしまいました。
dialogue.local: And some of the potion in the bottle spilled onto the dog.
dialogue.en: And some of the potion in the bottle spilled onto the dog.

dialogue.text: Bobby didn't understand what happened first.
dialogue.zh: Bobby一開始不明白發生了什麼事。
dialogue.ja: ボビーは最初、何が起こったのかわかりませんでした。
dialogue.local: Bobby didn't understand what happened first.
dialogue.en: Bobby didn't understand what happened first.

dialogue.text: Looked left and right, then turned into a giant candy.
dialogue.zh: 牠左右看了看，然後變成了一顆巨大的糖果。
dialogue.ja: 左右を見回した後、巨大なキャンディーに変わってしまいました。
dialogue.local: Looked left and right, then turned into a giant candy.
dialogue.en: Looked left and right, then turned into a giant candy.

dialogue.text: Seeing this, Fury looked at the potion bottle and her dog, which had turned into a candy.
dialogue.zh: 看到這一幕，Fury看著魔藥瓶和變成糖果的狗。
dialogue.ja: それを見て、フューリーは魔薬の瓶とキャンディーに変わった犬を見つめました。
dialogue.local: Seeing this, Fury looked at the potion bottle and her dog, which had turned into a candy.
dialogue.en: Seeing this, Fury looked at the potion bottle and her dog, which had turned into a candy.

dialogue.text: The candy was bouncing around and the witch was chasing after it anxiously.
dialogue.zh: 糖果彈跳著，女巫焦急地追著它。
dialogue.ja: キャンディーは跳ね回り、魔女は不安そうにそれを追いかけました。
dialogue.local: The candy was bouncing around and the witch was chasing after it anxiously.
dialogue.en: The candy was bouncing around and the witch was chasing after it anxiously.

dialogue.text: Bobby!
dialogue.zh: Bobby！
dialogue.ja: ボビー！
dialogue.local: Bobby!
dialogue.en: Bobby!

dialogue.text: Do not go!
dialogue.zh: 不要走！
dialogue.ja: 行かないで！
dialogue.local: Do not go!
dialogue.en: Do not go!

dialogue.text: I will fix this!
dialogue.zh: 我會修好的！
dialogue.ja: 直してみせる！
dialogue.local: I will fix this!
dialogue.en: I will fix this!

dialogue.text: Wait!
dialogue.zh: 等等！
dialogue.ja: 待って！
dialogue.local: Wait!
dialogue.en: Wait!

dialogue.text: Ah!
dialogue.zh: 啊！
dialogue.ja: あっ！
dialogue.local: Ah!
dialogue.en: Ah!

dialogue.text: I said stop!
dialogue.zh: 我說停下！
dialogue.ja: 止まれって言ったのに！
dialogue.local: I said stop!
dialogue.en: I said stop!

dialogue.text: Wait!
dialogue.zh: 等等！
dialogue.ja: 待って！
dialogue.local: Wait!
dialogue.en: Wait!

dialogue.text: The candy bounced around.
dialogue.zh: 糖果彈跳著。
dialogue.ja: キャンディーは跳ね回りました。
dialogue.local: The candy bounced around.
dialogue.en: The candy bounced around.

dialogue.text: First, popped out of the window, then fell into the pool below, and of course melted in an instant.
dialogue.zh: 先是跳出窗外，然後掉進下面的泳池，當然瞬間融化了。
dialogue.ja: 最初は窓から飛び出し、その後下のプールに落ち、もちろん一瞬で溶けてしまいました。
dialogue.local: First, popped out of the window, then fell into the pool below, and of course melted in an instant.
dialogue.en: First, popped out of the window, then fell into the pool below, and of course melted in an instant.

dialogue.text: The witch Fury looked sadly behind the melting candy.
dialogue.zh: 女巫Fury悲傷地望著融化的糖果。
dialogue.ja: 魔女フューリーは溶けていくキャンディーを悲しそうに見つめました。
dialogue.local: The witch Fury looked sadly behind the melting candy.
dialogue.en: The witch Fury looked sadly behind the melting candy.

dialogue.text: This incident spread from peer to ear among the town's people.
dialogue.zh: 這件事在鎮上人們間口耳相傳。
dialogue.ja: この出来事は町の人々の間で口コミで広まりました。
dialogue.local: This incident spread from peer to ear among the town's people.
dialogue.en: This incident spread from peer to ear among the town's people.

dialogue.text: Those who were fed up with the witch's evils thought she deserved it.
dialogue.zh: 那些受夠女巫壞事的人認為她活該。
dialogue.ja: 魔女の悪事にうんざりしていた人々は、彼女は当然の報いだと思いました。
dialogue.local: Those who were fed up with the witch's evils thought she deserved it.
dialogue.en: Those who were fed up with the witch's evils thought she deserved it.

dialogue.text: The witch living in the haunted mansion has finally been punished for her wickedness.
dialogue.zh: 住在鬧鬼大宅的女巫終於因她的邪惡受到懲罰。
dialogue.ja: 幽霊屋敷に住む魔女はついにその悪行の罰を受けました。
dialogue.local: The witch living in the haunted mansion has finally been punished for her wickedness.
dialogue.en: The witch living in the haunted mansion has finally been punished for her wickedness.

dialogue.text: Yeah, she won't be able to cast spells on us anymore.
dialogue.zh: 是啊，她再也不能對我們施法了。
dialogue.ja: そうだね、彼女はもう私たちに呪文をかけられないよ。
dialogue.local: Yeah, she won't be able to cast spells on us anymore.
dialogue.en: Yeah, she won't be able to cast spells on us anymore.

dialogue.text: I think we should celebrate that.
dialogue.zh: 我覺得我們應該慶祝這件事。
dialogue.ja: それを祝うべきだと思うよ。
dialogue.local: I think we should celebrate that.
dialogue.en: I think we should celebrate that.

dialogue.text: But she's just a clumsy witch, and she lost her dog just because of that.
dialogue.zh: 但她只是個笨拙的女巫，因為這樣她失去了她的狗。
dialogue.ja: でも彼女はただの不器用な魔女で、それが原因で犬を失ったんだよ。
dialogue.local: But she's just a clumsy witch, and she lost her dog just because of that.
dialogue.en: But she's just a clumsy witch, and she lost her dog just because of that.

dialogue.text: From that day on, the town's people celebrated the same day every year as Halloween.
dialogue.zh: 從那天起，鎮上的人們每年同一天慶祝萬聖節。
dialogue.ja: その日から、町の人々は毎年同じ日をハロウィンとして祝うようになりました。
dialogue.local: From that day on, the town's people celebrated the same day every year as Halloween.
dialogue.en: From that day on, the town's people celebrated the same day every year as Halloween.

dialogue.text: While the young girl named Millie was feeding street animals on the same day every year.
dialogue.zh: 而名叫Millie的小女孩每年同一天都在餵街上的動物。
dialogue.ja: そして、ミリーという若い女の子は毎年同じ日に街の動物たちに餌をあげていました。
dialogue.local: While the young girl named Millie was feeding street animals on the same day every year.
dialogue.en: While the young girl named Millie was feeding street animals on the same day every year.

dialogue.text: You're so playful, love's dog!
dialogue.zh: 你真調皮，親愛的狗狗！
dialogue.ja: 君は本当に遊び好きだね、愛しい犬よ！
dialogue.local: You're so playful, love's dog!
dialogue.en: You're so playful, love's dog!

dialogue.text: Jump!
dialogue.zh: 跳！
dialogue.ja: ジャンプ！
dialogue.local: Jump!
dialogue.en: Jump!

dialogue.text: Come on, jump!
dialogue.zh: 來，跳！
dialogue.ja: さあ、ジャンプして！
dialogue.local: Come on, jump!
dialogue.en: Come on, jump!

dialogue.text: A few years have passed.
dialogue.zh: 幾年過去了。
dialogue.ja: 数年が過ぎました。
dialogue.local: A few years have passed.
dialogue.en: A few years have passed.

dialogue.text: The witch Fury began to devise a plan to punish those who made fun of her.
dialogue.zh: 女巫Fury開始策劃懲罰那些取笑她的人。
dialogue.ja: 魔女フューリーは自分をからかった人たちを懲らしめる計画を立て始めました。
dialogue.local: The witch Fury began to devise a plan to punish those who made fun of her.
dialogue.en: The witch Fury began to devise a plan to punish those who made fun of her.

dialogue.text: That year, on Halloween, she disguised herself and wore a huge pumpkin headdress.
dialogue.zh: 那年萬聖節，她偽裝自己，戴上了一個巨大的南瓜頭飾。
dialogue.ja: その年のハロウィンに、彼女は変装して大きなカボチャのかぶり物をしました。
dialogue.local: That year, on Halloween, she disguised herself and wore a huge pumpkin headdress.
dialogue.en: That year, on Halloween, she disguised herself and wore a huge pumpkin headdress.

dialogue.text: In this way, she managed not to be recognized by anyone.
dialogue.zh: 這樣她成功沒被任何人認出。
dialogue.ja: こうして、誰にも気づかれずに済みました。
dialogue.local: In this way, she managed not to be recognized by anyone.
dialogue.en: In this way, she managed not to be recognized by anyone.

dialogue.text: I will punish all of you for making fun of me.
dialogue.zh: 我要懲罰所有取笑我的人。
dialogue.ja: 私をからかったみんなを懲らしめてやる。
dialogue.local: I will punish all of you for making fun of me.
dialogue.en: I will punish all of you for making fun of me.

dialogue.text: She took the potion bottle she had prepared and went out of her mansion for the first time in years.
dialogue.zh: 她拿著準備好的魔藥瓶，多年來第一次走出她的宅邸。
dialogue.ja: 彼女は用意した魔薬の瓶を持って、何年ぶりかに屋敷を出ました。
dialogue.local: She took the potion bottle she had prepared and went out of her mansion for the first time in years.
dialogue.en: She took the potion bottle she had prepared and went out of her mansion for the first time in years.

dialogue.text: And started knocking on the doors one by one.
dialogue.zh: 開始一戶一戶敲門。
dialogue.ja: そして、一軒ずつドアをノックし始めました。
dialogue.local: And started knocking on the doors one by one.
dialogue.en: And started knocking on the doors one by one.

dialogue.text: No one recognized the witch Fury.
dialogue.zh: 沒有人認出女巫Fury。
dialogue.ja: 誰も魔女フューリーだと気づきませんでした。
dialogue.local: No one recognized the witch Fury.
dialogue.en: No one recognized the witch Fury.

dialogue.text: Trick or treat?
dialogue.zh: 不給糖就搗蛋？
dialogue.ja: トリック・オア・トリート？
dialogue.local: Trick or treat?
dialogue.en: Trick or treat?

dialogue.text: Treat!
dialogue.zh: 給糖！
dialogue.ja: トリート！
dialogue.local: Treat!
dialogue.en: Treat!

dialogue.text: When the witch heard the word candy, she sprayed the man with her potion and turned him into a giant candy.
dialogue.zh: 當女巫聽到糖果這個詞時，她用魔藥噴了那個男人，讓他變成了一顆巨大的糖果。
dialogue.ja: 魔女はキャンディーという言葉を聞くと、その男に魔薬を吹きかけ、巨大なキャンディーに変えました。
dialogue.local: When the witch heard the word candy, she sprayed the man with her potion and turned him into a giant candy.
dialogue.en: When the witch heard the word candy, she sprayed the man with her potion and turned him into a giant candy.

dialogue.text: Ha ha ha ha!
dialogue.zh: 哈哈哈哈！
dialogue.ja: はははは！
dialogue.local: Ha ha ha ha!
dialogue.en: Ha ha ha ha!

dialogue.text: Now make fun of me!
dialogue.zh: 現在來取笑我吧！
dialogue.ja: さあ、私をからかってみろ！
dialogue.local: Now make fun of me!
dialogue.en: Now make fun of me!

dialogue.text: Then the witch went to the house next door.
dialogue.zh: 然後女巫走到隔壁的房子。
dialogue.ja: それから魔女は隣の家へ向かいました。
dialogue.local: Then the witch went to the house next door.
dialogue.en: Then the witch went to the house next door.

dialogue.text: This time, a kid opened the door.
dialogue.zh: 這次，一個小孩開了門。
dialogue.ja: 今度は子供がドアを開けました。
dialogue.local: This time, a kid opened the door.
dialogue.en: This time, a kid opened the door.

dialogue.text: Trick or treat?
dialogue.zh: 不給糖就搗蛋？
dialogue.ja: トリック・オア・トリート？
dialogue.local: Trick or treat?
dialogue.en: Trick or treat?

dialogue.text: Treat!
dialogue.zh: 給糖！
dialogue.ja: トリート！
dialogue.local: Treat!
dialogue.en: Treat!

dialogue.text: Here you go, treat!
dialogue.zh: 給你，糖果！
dialogue.ja: はい、どうぞ、トリート！
dialogue.local: Here you go, treat!
dialogue.en: Here you go, treat!

dialogue.text: Witch Fury turned the kid into a candy right there.
dialogue.zh: 女巫Fury當場把小孩變成了糖果。
dialogue.ja: 魔女フューリーはその場で子供をキャンディーに変えました。
dialogue.local: Witch Fury turned the kid into a candy right there.
dialogue.en: Witch Fury turned the kid into a candy right there.

dialogue.text: Meanwhile, Millie, who was out to feed the street animals, was very surprised to see huge candies bouncing around.
dialogue.zh: 同時，正在餵街上動物的Millie看到巨大的糖果跳來跳去，非常驚訝。
dialogue.ja: その間、街の動物に餌をあげていたミリーは、巨大なキャンディーが跳ね回っているのを見てとても驚きました。
dialogue.local: Meanwhile, Millie, who was out to feed the street animals, was very surprised to see huge candies bouncing around.
dialogue.en: Meanwhile, Millie, who was out to feed the street animals, was very surprised to see huge candies bouncing around.

dialogue.text: What?
dialogue.zh: 什麼？
dialogue.ja: 何？
dialogue.local: What?
dialogue.en: What?

dialogue.text: What's going on here?
dialogue.zh: 這裡發生什麼事？
dialogue.ja: ここで何が起こっているの？
dialogue.local: What's going on here?
dialogue.en: What's going on here?

dialogue.text: Where are those candies coming from?
dialogue.zh: 那些糖果從哪裡來的？
dialogue.ja: あのキャンディーはどこから来たの？
dialogue.local: Where are those candies coming from?
dialogue.en: Where are those candies coming from?

dialogue.text: Millie ran in the direction the candies were bouncing.
dialogue.zh: Millie朝著糖果跳動的方向跑去。
dialogue.ja: ミリーはキャンディーが跳ねている方向へ走りました。
dialogue.local: Millie ran in the direction the candies were bouncing.
dialogue.en: Millie ran in the direction the candies were bouncing.

dialogue.text: And she saw that someone in a pumpkin costume was laughing at the candy that passed in front of her.
dialogue.zh: 她看到一個穿著南瓜裝的人在笑著糖果從她面前跳過。
dialogue.ja: そして、彼女はカボチャの衣装を着た誰かが、目の前を通り過ぎるキャンディーを笑っているのを見ました。
dialogue.local: And she saw that someone in a pumpkin costume was laughing at the candy that passed in front of her.
dialogue.en: And she saw that someone in a pumpkin costume was laughing at the candy that passed in front of her.

dialogue.text: Hey!
dialogue.zh: 嘿！
dialogue.ja: ねえ！
dialogue.local: Hey!
dialogue.en: Hey!

dialogue.text: Who are you?
dialogue.zh: 你是誰？
dialogue.ja: あなたは誰？
dialogue.local: Who are you?
dialogue.en: Who are you?

dialogue.text: What are you doing to these people?
dialogue.zh: 你對這些人做了什麼？
dialogue.ja: この人たちに何をしているの？
dialogue.local: What are you doing to these people?
dialogue.en: What are you doing to these people?

dialogue.text: Stop now!
dialogue.zh: 現在停下！
dialogue.ja: 今すぐやめて！
dialogue.local: Stop now!
dialogue.en: Stop now!

dialogue.text: When the witch saw the young girl who was coming, running to her, she started to run away quickly.
dialogue.zh: 當女巫看到那個跑向她的年輕女孩時，她開始快速逃跑。
dialogue.ja: 魔女は走って近づいてくる若い女の子を見て、急いで逃げ始めました。
dialogue.local: When the witch saw the young girl who was coming, running to her, she started to run away quickly.
dialogue.en: When the witch saw the young girl who was coming, running to her, she started to run away quickly.

dialogue.text: They chased each other along the street.
dialogue.zh: 他們在街上追逐著彼此。
dialogue.ja: 二人は街中で追いかけっこをしました。
dialogue.local: They chased each other along the street.
dialogue.en: They chased each other along the street.

dialogue.text: Finally, Millie caught this oddly disguised witch, and took off her hood.
dialogue.zh: 最後，Millie抓住了這個奇怪裝扮的女巫，並摘下她的帽子。
dialogue.ja: ついにミリーは奇妙な変装をした魔女を捕まえ、フードを脱がせました。
dialogue.local: Finally, Millie caught this oddly disguised witch, and took off her hood.
dialogue.en: Finally, Millie caught this oddly disguised witch, and took off her hood.

dialogue.text: She was very surprised to see that it was witch Fury.
dialogue.zh: 她非常驚訝地發現那是女巫Fury。
dialogue.ja: それが魔女フューリーだと知って、とても驚きました。
dialogue.local: She was very surprised to see that it was witch Fury.
dialogue.en: She was very surprised to see that it was witch Fury.

dialogue.text: Ah ha!
dialogue.zh: 啊哈！
dialogue.ja: あは！
dialogue.local: Ah ha!
dialogue.en: Ah ha!

dialogue.text: Witch Fury!
dialogue.zh: 女巫Fury！
dialogue.ja: 魔女フューリー！
dialogue.local: Witch Fury!
dialogue.en: Witch Fury!

dialogue.text: It's you!
dialogue.zh: 是你！
dialogue.ja: あなたなのね！
dialogue.local: It's you!
dialogue.en: It's you!

dialogue.text: Where are you doing evil things to people again after years?
dialogue.zh: 多年後你又開始對人們做壞事了嗎？
dialogue.ja: 何年も経ってまた人々に悪さをしているの？
dialogue.local: Where are you doing evil things to people again after years?
dialogue.en: Where are you doing evil things to people again after years?

dialogue.text: You should stop now!
dialogue.zh: 你應該現在停止！
dialogue.ja: 今すぐやめるべきよ！
dialogue.local: You should stop now!
dialogue.en: You should stop now!

dialogue.text: The townspeople deserve it, Millie!
dialogue.zh: 鎮上的人活該，Millie！
dialogue.ja: 町の人たちは当然の報いだ、ミリー！
dialogue.local: The townspeople deserve it, Millie!
dialogue.en: The townspeople deserve it, Millie!

dialogue.text: While I'm sad to lose my dog, they're celebrating this day!
dialogue.zh: 雖然我因失去我的狗而難過，但他們卻在慶祝這一天！
dialogue.ja: 犬を失って悲しいけれど、彼らはこの日を祝っているんだ！
dialogue.local: While I'm sad to lose my dog, they're celebrating this day!
dialogue.en: While I'm sad to lose my dog, they're celebrating this day!

dialogue.text: Millie realized that the witch Fury was very sorry for her dog, and that she has actually been alone for years.
dialogue.zh: Millie意識到女巫Fury非常想念她的狗，實際上她已經孤獨多年。
dialogue.ja: ミリーは魔女フューリーが犬をとても恋しがっていて、実は何年も一人でいたことに気づきました。
dialogue.local: Millie realized that the witch Fury was very sorry for her dog, and that she has actually been alone for years.
dialogue.en: Millie realized that the witch Fury was very sorry for her dog, and that she has actually been alone for years.

dialogue.text: I understand you, but the solution is not to hurt people!
dialogue.zh: 我理解你，但解決方法不是傷害別人！
dialogue.ja: あなたの気持ちはわかるけど、解決策は人を傷つけることじゃないよ！
dialogue.local: I understand you, but the solution is not to hurt people!
dialogue.en: I understand you, but the solution is not to hurt people!

dialogue.text: Kindness always wins!
dialogue.zh: 善良總是會勝利！
dialogue.ja: 優しさはいつも勝つんだ！
dialogue.local: Kindness always wins!
dialogue.en: Kindness always wins!

dialogue.text: I have a great idea!
dialogue.zh: 我有個好主意！
dialogue.ja: いい考えがあるよ！
dialogue.local: I have a great idea!
dialogue.en: I have a great idea!

dialogue.text: Wait a minute!
dialogue.zh: 等一下！
dialogue.ja: ちょっと待って！
dialogue.local: Wait a minute!
dialogue.en: Wait a minute!

dialogue.text: Millie embraced the little puppy, who was trying to play with the bouncing candies in the square, and brought him to the witch.
dialogue.zh: Millie抱起那隻試圖和廣場上跳動的糖果玩耍的小狗，帶他去找女巫。
dialogue.ja: ミリーは広場で跳ねるキャンディーと遊ぼうとしている子犬を抱きしめて、魔女のところへ連れて行きました。
dialogue.local: Millie embraced the little puppy, who was trying to play with the bouncing candies in the square, and brought him to the witch.
dialogue.en: Millie embraced the little puppy, who was trying to play with the bouncing candies in the square, and brought him to the witch.

dialogue.text: Here, look!
dialogue.zh: 看這裡！
dialogue.ja: ほら、見て！
dialogue.local: Here, look!
dialogue.en: Here, look!

dialogue.text: How innocent is he?
dialogue.zh: 牠多麼純真啊！
dialogue.ja: 彼はなんて無邪気なんだろう！
dialogue.local: How innocent is he?
dialogue.en: How innocent is he?

dialogue.text: This beautiful creature may now want to live with you!
dialogue.zh: 這個美麗的生物現在可能想和你一起生活！
dialogue.ja: この美しい生き物は今、あなたと一緒に暮らしたいと思っているかもしれません！
dialogue.local: This beautiful creature may now want to live with you!
dialogue.en: This beautiful creature may now want to live with you!

dialogue.text: Witch Fury was overjoyed when she saw the dog, because he looked just like her old dog, Bobby!
dialogue.zh: 女巫Fury看到這隻狗非常高興，因為牠看起來就像她以前的狗Bobby！
dialogue.ja: 魔女フューリーはその犬を見て大喜びしました。まるで昔の犬、ボビーのようだったからです！
dialogue.local: Witch Fury was overjoyed when she saw the dog, because he looked just like her old dog, Bobby!
dialogue.en: Witch Fury was overjoyed when she saw the dog, because he looked just like her old dog, Bobby!

dialogue.text: But this, he looks a lot like my dog!
dialogue.zh: 但是這隻，他長得很像我的狗！
dialogue.ja: でもこれは、私の犬にそっくりだ！
dialogue.local: But this, he looks a lot like my dog!
dialogue.en: But this, he looks a lot like my dog!

dialogue.text: I can't believe it!
dialogue.zh: 我不敢相信！
dialogue.ja: 信じられない！
dialogue.local: I can't believe it!
dialogue.en: I can't believe it!

dialogue.text: Oh, he's so sweet!
dialogue.zh: 哦，他真可愛！
dialogue.ja: ああ、彼はとてもかわいい！
dialogue.local: Oh, he's so sweet!
dialogue.en: Oh, he's so sweet!

dialogue.text: If you promise to stop doing evil to the townspeople, this puppy can live with you for a lifetime, and be very happy!
dialogue.zh: 如果你答應不再對鎮上的人做壞事，這隻小狗可以和你一起生活一輩子，非常快樂！
dialogue.ja: もし町の人々に悪さをやめると約束するなら、この子犬は一生あなたと暮らし、とても幸せになれるよ！
dialogue.local: If you promise to stop doing evil to the townspeople, this puppy can live with you for a lifetime, and be very happy!
dialogue.en: If you promise to stop doing evil to the townspeople, this puppy can live with you for a lifetime, and be very happy!

dialogue.text: The witch's heart became softer as she loved the dog, the evil in her suddenly disappeared.
dialogue.zh: 女巫的心因為愛上這隻狗而變得柔軟，她心中的邪惡突然消失了。
dialogue.ja: 犬を愛するうちに魔女の心は柔らかくなり、彼女の中の悪が突然消えました。
dialogue.local: The witch's heart became softer as she loved the dog, the evil in her suddenly disappeared.
dialogue.en: The witch's heart became softer as she loved the dog, the evil in her suddenly disappeared.

dialogue.text: I promise, this dog will now be my best friend!
dialogue.zh: 我保證，這隻狗現在會是我最好的朋友！
dialogue.ja: 約束するよ、この犬はこれから私の一番の友達になる！
dialogue.local: I promise, this dog will now be my best friend!
dialogue.en: I promise, this dog will now be my best friend!

dialogue.text: Thank you, young girl!
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你，年輕的女孩！
dialogue.ja: ありがとう、若い女の子！
dialogue.local: Thank you, young girl!
dialogue.en: Thank you, young girl!

dialogue.text: The witch, with her newly adopted dog, turned all the candies that were bouncing on the street back to their old human form.
dialogue.zh: 女巫和她新收養的狗一起，將街上跳動的糖果全都變回了原本的人形。
dialogue.ja: 魔女は新しく迎えた犬と一緒に、街で跳ねていたキャンディーをすべて元の人間の姿に戻しました。
dialogue.local: The witch, with her newly adopted dog, turned all the candies that were bouncing on the street back to their old human form.
dialogue.en: The witch, with her newly adopted dog, turned all the candies that were bouncing on the street back to their old human form.

dialogue.text: She named her beloved dog, Candy.
dialogue.zh: 她給她心愛的狗取名為Candy。
dialogue.ja: 彼女は愛犬にキャンディーと名付けました。
dialogue.local: She named her beloved dog, Candy.
dialogue.en: She named her beloved dog, Candy.

dialogue.text: Since then, Fury has gone out on the streets to do the street animals of favor every Halloween.
dialogue.zh: 從那時起，Fury每年萬聖節都會走上街頭幫助街上的動物。
dialogue.ja: それ以来、フューリーは毎年ハロウィンに街に出て、街の動物たちに親切にしています。
dialogue.local: Since then, Fury has gone out on the streets to do the street animals of favor every Halloween.
dialogue.en: Since then, Fury has gone out on the streets to do the street animals of favor every Halloween.

dialogue.text: Just like Millie!
dialogue.zh: 就像Millie一樣！
dialogue.ja: ミリーのように！
dialogue.local: Just like Millie!
dialogue.en: Just like Millie!

dialogue.text: And her dog, Candy, has never left her alone!
dialogue.zh: 而她的狗Candy從未離開過她！
dialogue.ja: そして彼女の犬キャンディーは決して彼女を一人にしません！
dialogue.local: And her dog, Candy, has never left her alone!
dialogue.en: And her dog, Candy, has never left her alone!
